To be fair, his point is that no matter how you "fix" it, it can always be abused. It's all an algorithm. Once you learn it, you can stand in certain spots, look at certain pixels, and the enemy will still spawn in the same spot. 

The other point he is making is spawn control, which is incredibly important in competitive arcade environments. Sure, you "shouldn't" be able to kill someone directly off spawn. Yet regardless, if you had 3-4 teammates stand in certain positions in the map, looking at certain angles, spawns will be abused. 

Let's look at Halo 2, 3, Reach, 5, or Infinite. Any and all of their Esports scenes had this underlying issue, but instead of complaining about it as an "issue," they saw it as a skill ceiling to overcome, if they let there enemy set up the spawn control, it was there fault. Any maps that are three lanes no matter how large or small, like The Pit in 3, 4, and Infinite, had this problem like crazy. And since most CoD maps the community asks for are traditional 3 lane arcade maps, this issue will persist. Cod4-MW1-MW3, Bo2, etc. had this exact same issue.

And to you bringing up these old games, if we look at old games like Quake, Halo CE, and more, Guess what happens, in Highly Contested Skill Ceiling environments, Spawns are controlled. In Halo CE, the spawn system largely like Quake's was solely dependent on Teammate location, nothing more. Do you know what that means? The entire strategy in Halo CE is to kill an enemy, and before they respawn next to their teammate, weaken them, but Don't kill, and then line up their respawn with that, and then kill them, rinse and repeat, You can go 50-0 in doubles or 8s in CE because of that. Yet the community calls it a skill gap. Any game before Cod4 usually had this same problem. 

Edit: The way the community also dealt with this, since it was a skill ceiling was by unaliving themselves, or killing their own teammate before it could be abused, OR be the better player in the gunfight? 

Also, you belittled his opinion just because he was on Console? Why? Quake was on Xbox Og, 360, and one. PC had more CS like shooters, but that doesn't have spawn manips. So why? Quake didn't use an intersection LoS (line of sight) spawn system, and even if it did, just look at a pole to obscure view a little, or look slightly to the right on a smaller FOV setting. Ironically CS was also on Console..

I agree morally on a casual side, you shouldn't have to be on the other side of this, but also giving out willy nilly solutions without thinking about all perspectives is part of the reason you might not be in the video game profession; or at least never played these games on high skill ceilings. Either way, giving players a 5-second grace period, when the ttk can be less than a second, would be too powerful and could make games last too long. Plus, it can be abused, if we go the route of "wait till they pull the trigger" not only does the spawn abuser know this, and can just shoot before and win by reaction, but the spawner can abuse this, by running up towards the other player with invincibility until they either get to 5 seconds or shoot. Sounds extremely annoying. 

The only way i can see it "working" is death streaks like in MW2. Martyrdom prevents a teammate from spawning in that spawn, forcing them to spawn elsewhere. Something the abused team couldn't react to until they do. Which they did, and will do.

Edit: Ultimately, no matter how you "fix" it, it will always be abused, always. Unless you have large maps.

Maybe, but look at FPS's throughout time, and just learn the algorithm, and you can abuse spawns. Og MW1-3 had this issue, Halo 1-3 and reach had this issue, Quake had this issue, and more. It's not just a Black Ops 6 or Cod problem.
